source_data: gateC pilot, 60 frozen candidates, 1,329 researched comp rows

rule.name: RESEARCH_WATCH
rule.meaning: this auction merits monitoring or later re-evaluation; it is not an executable price, not a purchase recommendation and not an actionable BUY
conditions_all_required: conservative_valuation = p25 of accepted comps (not the median)
cost_floor = current_bid + shipping when shipping is KNOWN, otherwise current_bid alone and explicitly a floor
mandatory_display: reserve UNKNOWN shown as an unresolved blocker
current bid or opening price labelled provisional
unknown shipping never treated as zero and the total marked a floor

best_candidate.title: 1992 Topps Stadium Club Beam Team #20 David Robinson

two_positive_margin_candidates.title: 1983 Topps #329 Randy Niemann PSA 10
two_positive_margin_candidates.why: the +6.8% margin came from the median; against the conservative p25 the bid is 72.6% above valuation. One $50 sale drags p25 far below the median, which is exactly what a conservative statistic is for.

two_positive_margin_candidates.title: 2000 Fleer Tradition #353 Cal Ripken Jr. PSA 10
two_positive_margin_candidates.why: a single accepted comp cannot establish a valuation

negative_margin_candidates_recheck.why: an auction price only rises, so a candidate already at or above conservative valuation can never become attractive. This is a deterministic permanent exclusion, not a deferred decision.

no_valuation_candidates.handling: never RESEARCH_WATCH and never rechecked. Absent comps are absent evidence, and a recheck refreshes price only - it does not re-run Product Research, so it cannot create a valuation.

recheck_design_if_authorized.scope: existing RESEARCH_WATCH candidates only, never all discovered auctions
recheck_design_if_authorized.interval: 90 minutes before end_time (within the 60-120 minute band)
fields_refreshed: genuine fixed asking price if present
recheck_design_if_authorized.product_research: not rerun while slab identity and accepted comps are unchanged
recheck_design_if_authorized.after_refresh: recompute headroom against the unchanged conservative valuation
recheck_design_if_authorized.dedup: one alert per item_id per state change; previous bid, previous bid count and previous observation time recorded on every alert

structural_finding: A recheck can only ever reduce headroom, never create it, because auction prices only rise. RESEARCH_WATCH membership decided at discovery is therefore an upper bound and a later recheck can only remove candidates. With 0 qualifying at discovery there is nothing for a recheck to act on, and 59 of the 60 exclusions are for reasons a recheck cannot change: missing comps, insufficient comps, wide comp ranges, or a price already above valuation.
scope_note: Bidding is outside the authorized scope, so no auction can be acquired by this project as currently scoped regardless of what a recheck finds. That is a scope fact, not a permanent verdict on auctions.
defects_found: none - the extreme negative margins were verified against source comps (Cale Makar UD Canvas #C94 PSA 10: 28 accepted CANVAS comps, median $225, opening bid $725) and reflect genuine above-market openings, not identity or parallel leakage
